title: Check the right endpoint
text: At $$x=1$$ the series is the alternating series of $$\frac{{\left(-1\right)}^n}{\sqrt{n}}$$, which converges by the alternating series test.

title: Check the left endpoint
text: At $$x=-1$$ it becomes the sum of $$\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$$, which diverges because the power of $$n$$ in the denominator is $$\frac{1}{2}$$, which is less than $$1$$. So the interval is (-1,1].
